summary: Iteration 2 focused on the 4 new modules: pre-reservation emails, Users CRUD RBAC, Occupancy heatmap, and PIX BR Code generator. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass. Frontend: admin flows (Users create + role select + reset-password dialog, Heatmap render + prev/next nav, WhatsApp PIX QR generation) all work; Reception sidebar correctly hides Ocupação/Quartos/Site/iCal/Financeiro/Usuários and shows Visão Geral/Calendário/Reservas/WhatsApp/Conta. One integration issue: Visão Geral (dashboard) fires 403s for reception (likely calls finance/summary or rooms) triggering an unhandled-rejection toast overlay.

integration_issues.issue: Dashboard performs at least one admin-only GET (finance/summary or similar) that returns 403 for reception; unhandled promise rejection surfaces as a global Emergent error dialog on first load after login.

issues: DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description (accessibility warning in console). Minor a11y polish.

action_items: In DashboardPage (Visão Geral), guard finance/rooms admin-only calls behind role check or handle 403 silently so reception users don't see the global unhandled-rejection dialog.
Optional: add DialogDescription to user dialogs to remove Radix a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1300 lines; consider splitting into modules (auth, users, reservations, finance, ical, pix, email) as it grows.
Occupancy heatmap: uses in-memory priority map – correct and O(rooms*res*days). Fine for expected pousada size.
PIX brcode: CRC16-CCITT computed correctly (verified against local recomputation with amount=250.50).
Emails: safe-email guardrail (_assert_safe_email) enforces https-only + no forms + no credential prompts; both templates pass.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_ users/rooms/reservations during tests – all cleaned up or soft-deleted where possible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new modules verified end-to-end. Only follow-up: reception dashboard triggers 403 toast. If main agent guards admin-only calls, re-run frontend reception smoke to confirm no error dialog appears on /admin.
rca of the issue: Reception 403 dashboard toast: DashboardPage on load calls admin-role-restricted endpoints (finance/summary, finance/monthly, or rooms admin list). Backend correctly returns 403; frontend does not swallow the rejection so global error boundary surfaces it. Mitigation: check user.role before dispatching those calls, or wrap in try/catch to noop for reception.
